notes: Independent exhaustive checking of all indexed 3-element subsets found no triple summing to 6, so S = [3,3,3,1,1,1] is a 3Partition NO instance. The written transformation produces 24 elements but is already invalid as a 12Partition instance because its 18 zeros violate the positive-integer input requirement. Even under a relaxed nonnegative interpretation, the output is YES: blocks {3,3}+10 zeros and {3,1,1,1}+8 zeros each contain 12 elements and sum to 6. Their nonzero counts are 2 and 4, disproving the claimed 3-per-block forcing. The refuted forcing statement is a substantive claim essential to the reverse direction, not a typo the author plainly did not mean.
